name: appdyno-workspace

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p test-device/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.lint: eslint packages scripts test-device '*.{js,ts}' && prettier --check packages scripts test-device docs ios .github '*.{md,json,js,ts,yaml,yml}'
scripts.format: prettier --write packages scripts test-device docs ios .github '*.{md,json,js,ts,yaml,yml}'
scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

description: A local device automation server for mobile QA: one MCP stdio server (`appdyno-mcp`) and a TypeScript host library (`appdyno`) that drive the iOS simulator, real iPhones, the Android emulator and real Android phones through our own on-device agents, and measure app and device performance on each of them.
